# espalier_volume (Resource)

A volume of the container runtime (`container volume create`): a disk image on the host that containers mount. The runtime cannot change a volume, so changing any argument replaces it, and with it the data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without a size, the runtime creates a sparse 512 GiB disk image.
resource "espalier_volume" "data" {
  name = "registry-data"
}

resource "espalier_volume" "cache" {
  name = "build-cache"
  size = "20G"
  labels = {
    owner = "ci"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the volume.
- `options` (Map of String) Driver-specific options (`--opt key=value`). Use `size` for the size, not an option.
- `size` (String) Size in bytes, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix, e.g. `2G`. If not set, the runtime creates a sparse 512 GiB image.

### Read-Only

- `format` (String) Filesystem of the volume, e.g. `ext4`.
- `id` (String) The volume's name.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the volume in bytes.
- `source` (String) Host path of the volume's disk image.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Volumes are imported by name.
terraform import espalier_volume.data registry-data
```
